verdict.rationale: Docs confirm network tokens exist and that Adyen sends webhooks for token lifecycle events when cards are added to wallets like Apple Pay/Google Pay (docs-36), implying some visibility into token creation/removal per wallet. However there is no evidence of an API to list/query existing tokens, identify which merchant holds them, or revoke a token independently of the underlying PAN. missing for 10: token listing/query API, merchant/wallet-holder attribution details, explicit token revocation endpoint separate from card suspension.
